Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
We delivered record revenue of $33.2 billion this quarter, representing 23% year-over-year growth.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 23% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 196 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 108 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
